mapper.select: select u.id, u.username, u.password, u.age, u.role_id, u.sex, u.sex as `sex_name`, u.email, u.qq, u.wechat, u.address, u.avatar, u.phone, r.name as `role_name`, u.create_time, u.update_time from smart_villages_permission.user u left join smart_villages_permission.role r on u.role_id = r.id where u.id = #{id} and u.deleted = 0 and r.deleted = 0 and u.status = 0
